mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.task_name, t.source_id, case when t.source_id is null then '内置本地数据源' else (select name from data_source where id = t.source_id) end as source_name, t.db_name, t.table_name, t.limit_rows, t.enabled, t.cron_expression, t.misfire_policy, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, (select count(*) from dq_task_rule tr where tr.task_id = t.task_id) as rule_count, (select r.status from dq_task_run r where r.task_id = t.task_id order by r.run_id desc limit 1) as last_run_status, (select r.started_at from dq_task_run r where r.task_id = t.task_id order by r.run_id desc limit 1) as last_run_at from dq_task t
mapper.select: where t.enabled = 1 and t.cron_expression is not null and t.cron_expression <> '' order by t.task_id
mapper.insert: insert into dq_task (task_name, source_id, db_name, table_name, limit_rows, enabled, cron_expression, misfire_policy, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskName}, #{sourceId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{dbName}, #{tableName}, #{limitRows}, #{enabled}, #{cronExpression}, #{misfirePolicy}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update dq_task set task_name = #{taskName}, source_id = #{sourceId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, db_name = #{dbName}, table_name = #{tableName}, limit_rows = #{limitRows}, enabled = #{enabled}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, misfire_policy = #{misfirePolicy}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where task_id = #{taskId}
